app_fee.value: The application fee is $60 for all graduate applicants, and international graduate students also pay a non-refundable $50 orientation fee at application.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $60 is required with all applications payable when application is submitted

also.quote: All international graduate students must pay a non-refundable $50 orientation fee, due at the time of application submission

fee_waiver.value: The university waives the fee only for McNair Scholars; departments may waive it case by case.
fee_waiver.quote: We waive the $60 application fee for McNair Scholars

gre_general.value: Each department decides whether the GRE is required; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: must be submitted if required by the major department

toefl_min.value: Set by each department; see the program records.

ielts_min.value: Set by each department; see the program records.

english_waiver.value: The graduate school sets no country-wide exemption for Indian degrees; each department sets its own English rule.
english_waiver.quote: Admission standards are the same for all students, regardless of country of origin or residency

notes: Graduate school rules only. Each department sets its own GRE and TOEFL/IELTS minimums; the roadmap says programs 'have different requirements, ranging from GPA and prerequisite courses to English language proficiency and standardized tests, such as the GRE'.
